explication: Datadog’s iOS/tvOS SDK initializes a shared core, enables product features, collects or instruments application activity, and persists/uploads telemetry. The principal user workflow is application setup → feature activation → manual or automatic event capture → delivery to Datadog. The graph emphasizes documented Logs, Traces, RUM, and WebView tracking, plus core context, storage, upload, and profiling layers. Several feature implementations are unsampled; their presence and some capabilities are documented, but uncertain internal call paths are omitted.
